Many businesses rely on enterprise and innovation to manage uncertainty and ensure sustained growth. This course teaches students to become an effective entrepreneur and an innovative leader – with the insight to identify opportunities, implement new processes, harness new technology and transform global businesses into market leaders.

Students will discover how to identify and develop a potential market opportunity, and drive sustained business growth – undertaking market research, making strategic decisions, managing uncertainty, exploring new technology, generating ideas and overcoming challenges.

Working with classmates, students will construct a business plan for a new profitable offering and work together to refine it – for instance, analysing the cost implications of adding or subtracting certain features. By doing this, students will gain a solid grounding in business principles and a deep understanding of how enterprises thrive: learning core competencies like finance, law, regulations, operations and organisational behaviour, while developing specialist skills, creative thinking, strategic decision-making and ability to innovate, globally.

From global organisations to new start-ups, studying in London offers opportunities to engage with all aspects of the business arena – gaining valuable work experience and meeting influential industry contacts.

Students will join bootcamps, simulations and creative labs to learn to think like a leader and an entrepreneur, and work on live briefs commissioned by industry experts that will expose them to real-world business issues and give them the strategic skills to combat them.

Students will graduate with a practical, future-facing business education that's entrepreneurial, network-driven and tech engaged.

Program Description

This integrated foundation year has been specially designed to give students the introductory knowledge and business skills needed to confidently progress to degree-level study.

The Foundation year is structured around an entrepreneurial challenge, with modules that introduce the transferable skills they will need at degree level and beyond.

Once students have successfully completed the foundation year, they will progress to the first year of BA (Hons) Global Management (Finance).

Students will gain a solid grounding in management principles, together with a broad set of business skills. Building upon this foundation, they will develop specialist knowledge in your chosen pathway.

The Finance Pathway

The Finance pathway offers a holistic approach to financial management and fintech. Students will explore the inner workings of financial corporations and consider the influence and impact of emerging technologies.

A global perspective is a core aspect. Learning about other cultures and interacting with students from all over the world will prepare them to work in the global business arena. Students will also have the opportunity to learn a new language.

Program Description

This integrated foundation year has been specially designed to give students the introductory knowledge and business skills needed to confidently progress to degree-level study.

The Foundation year is structured around an entrepreneurial challenge, with modules that introduce the transferable skills students will need at degree level and beyond.

Once students have successfully completed their foundation year, they will progress to the first year of BA (Hons) Business and Marketing.

Students will gain a solid grounding in management principles, together with a broad set of business skills. Building upon this foundation, students will develop specialist knowledge in their chosen course.

The global marketplace is constantly being reshaped by new technologies, emerging trends and shifting audiences. In order to compete in this environment, students will need to develop innovative and flexible strategies that meet the ever-changing demands.

This course focuses on marketing theory and practice – helping students to grow into a media-savvy marketer with the confidence to respond to rapid market changes, develop integrated strategies, build creative campaigns and convert targets into leads while managing teams across the globe.

Students will examine current debates, such as the extent to which big data will replace traditional data collection methods and start to think from a marketing communications (marcomms) perspective – developing new campaign objectives and crafting effective messages, supported by independent research and competitor analysis.

Practical, experience-based simulations and challenges with industry experts will expose students to real-world business issues and prepare them with the hands-on experience needed to develop and launch a luxury enterprise.

Students will have the option to undertake an independent placement or enterprise project to gain further industry experience, or they can study abroad for a term at one of Regent’s University London's international partners to broaden their understanding of management and enterprise in a global context. Students will also have the opportunity to learn a new language – preparing them to work in an international arena.

Program Description

Bachelor of Arts (Honours) - Business and Data Science with Integrated foundation helps students to get an interdisciplinary education, designed to equip you with the knowledge and skills to apply current and emerging data science techniques in a business context. The course places students at the forefront of industries in which business and data science intersect. Students will gain skills that are currently in high demand—enabling you to become a successful business professional with a sound grasp on the fundamentals of data science. You will learn technical skills, apply business knowledge, gain practical experience, and cover topics like finance, organizational culture, data analytics, statistics, data visualization, and business strategy.

Students' learning will be theoretical, conceptual, and practical, and always aligned with industry, so students can gain hands-on skills for their career in data science.

This course helps students to become:

  • Proficient in the integration of business acumen and data science tools and
  • Techniques
  • A data-driven decision-maker at operational and strategic levels
  • Entrepreneurial and network-driven.
  • Globally, culturally, and ethically responsive

Program Description

This degree with integrated foundation aims to prepare students for a professional and creative career as an interior designer.

The integrated foundation has been specially designed to give students the introductory knowledge and skills needed to confidently progress to degree-level study.

In the foundation year, students will develop a broad understanding of the creative industries, touching on aspects of fashion design, fashion marketing, illustration, interior design and graphic design.

Once students have successfully completed the foundation year, they will progress to the first year of BA (Hons) Interior Design

Regent's University London's holistic approach to interior design will enable students to develop their own design philosophy.

Students will be introduced to a broad range of design methods and principles, including digital technologies and professional standards. Approaching a range of public and private spaces, students will consider design ideas from a variety of perspectives including history, architecture, social and environment impact as well as purpose.

Model-making is a core element of this degree. Students create models of design ideas using specialist facilities and document the end product in our photography studio.

Professional practice modules will give opportunities to work on live projects with real clients. Students will be expected to consider all aspects of the design process from creative development to commercial and financial factors.

When you graduate, students will have a diverse portfolio of work that can be showcased to potential clients and employers.

This bespoke training will prepare students for a creative career across a wide range of sectors including commercial, residential, exhibition and installation and places of leisure and culture.

This tailormade course has been designed to help students build an international career in a dynamic business environment.

Students will expand their international business career by learning to analyse data, make difficult decisions and implement new strategies in fast-paced, international environments – with practical exercises exposing them to real-life business issues, training them to respond effectively in complex global organisations.

Students will gain a solid understanding of how international business thrive, as well as their problems, drivers of change and cultural dynamics – while building on their knowledge of disciplines including strategic management, finance, marketing and entrepreneurship.

Students will also develop the strategic expertise and creative communication skills needed to succeed in an ever-changing global marketplace, and learn a business-critical language to improve their skills in operating across cultures in international settings.

In the final term, students will either complete a major business project or a written dissertation – researching, analysing and applying their knowledge to a real business case.

Program Description

This course combines traditional media studies with new practices emerging in the 21st century – teaching students how to innovate, anticipate, analyse and utilise communications across a variety of media platforms.

Students will cover a range of traditional and modern communicative practices across the arts, sciences, humanities, business and industry – exploring how the field is shaped by digital advances. This interdisciplinary approach will give students a thorough grounding in media and communications: as an academic field, a cultural landscape and a complex network of industries.

Examining theories, students will discover the powerful influence media and communications can have socially, culturally and politically – gaining a critical understanding of media and transmedia creation and consumption. Looking at current global issues, students will develop the skills to monitor and analyse audience perceptions and interactions, and implement creative strategies to overcome challenges – using emerging tools and methods like data scraping and data visualisation.

Students will choose from a variety of electives to tailor their studies to topics that interest them – from transmedia storytelling to media regulations, social media marketing, creative economies and even human connection – exploring how dating apps use algorithms to shape matches.

In the final term, students will complete a dissertation, creative project or industry placement – consolidating their learning and gaining insights into one of the most progressive and exciting industries in the world.

The world of finance was one of the first to adopt today's advances in technology. On this course, students will master the skills needed to work with complex and dynamic financial markets – utilising integrated financial technology and responding to change at pace.

Students will learn to analyse the financial technology (fintech) and innovation sector, explore the digital investment space (including crowd sourcing and crowd funding) and examine new technological disruptions that aim to make financial services more accessible and efficient, personal and secure – including AI, cryptocurrency, cognitive computing, big data and blockchain.

Students will become skilled at analysing new data and connectivity, evaluating technological intelligence and managing risks and uncertainty.

Classes are designed to simulate a real-life experience of the financial industry. Students will benefit from hands-on training in economics software (with access to Thomson Reuters Eikon Terminals, Bloomberg L.P Terminals, Datastream databases and trading rooms on campus), as well as the chance to collaborate with students from all over the world to gain a global insight.

Studying in London, students will have access to financial networks, banking organisations and high-net-worth clients, as well as workshops and industry speakers – exposing them to new insights.

Students will become a financial player with the skills to innovate, analyse new technology and evaluate risks – making financial services more efficient and secure. Students will understand the wider financial industry (from corporate finance to investments) and work across international markets.

This course is also accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) and, upon completion, students will receive a Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership Practice alongside their degree.
